scope: Five actual owner-requested documentation captures. No mockups or replacement artwork. Native0.2.5; unchanged Companion0.3.1.

docs/screenshots/widescreen-world.png.title: Wider world, including original vehicles
docs/screenshots/widescreen-world.png.caption: A true 400-pixel scene shows terrain and an original parked vehicle beyond the original viewport. Selected-resource, completed-packet and raster guards preserve the original center; unsupported scenes use the original view. This is an isolated staged development checkpoint, not a naturally completed campaign.

docs/screenshots/battle-health-sidebar.p.title: Battle health at a glance
docs/screenshots/battle-health-sidebar.p.caption: The optional native battle sidebar displays enemy HP and health bars beside the original battle view. Hide or show it with your assigned keyboard/controller action in Companion Hotkeys. The redundant HUD-key footer has been removed.

docs/screenshots/quest-journal.png.title: Quest directions while the game runs
docs/screenshots/quest-journal.png.caption: The journal shows an objective, route advice and current progress from verified original dialogue and flags. This Mayor/Ringo clue was executed through the original event after a staged chapter prerequisite. Further chapters and permanent quest history remain in development.

docs/screenshots/companion-enhancements..title: Choose your own pace
docs/screenshots/companion-enhancements..caption: Separate XP and gold modifiers range from 100% to 1000%; held ordinary movement boost ranges from 100% to 300%. Faster menus, enemy HP information and the journal are configurable. These are example settings from an isolated profile.

docs/screenshots/companion-hotkeys.png.title: Keyboard and controller hotkeys
docs/screenshots/companion-hotkeys.png.caption: Assign fullscreen, HUD, journal, movement boost, checkpoints and more to keyboard/controller actions. Fast-forward supports hold or toggle. These are example custom bindings; game-button mapping has its own Controls page.
